text:
maria: Heads-up — the Python sample app (onboarding flow) is triggering 429 storms when STS creds rotate. Repro steps in prod staging. Seen across a few customer sandboxes.

maria: Repro is pretty short: start ~20 concurrent paginator workers, let creds expire (short-lived STS), observe 401 -> retry -> burst of parallel refresh attempts -> a bunch of 429s from the gateway.

maria: Example snippet from the sample app:```
p = Redwood.Paginator("/v1/embeds", page_size=50, concurrency=8)
for page in p:
    resp = client.embed(page)
```

maria: SDK config is default retry/backoff + auth middleware that does async refresh. Suspect we don't gate other requests while refresh is in flight.

tasha: I can repro locally with the sample harness. If I force creds TTL to 5s the windowing collapses into a spike. :grimacing:

rahul: Sounds like an auth stampede. Our JS SDK has a refresh lock, but Py parity is missing?

emily: Confirmed — py-sdk currently launches refresh per call when token expired because the refresh token check is racy in the async path. There is no in-flight promise dedupe.

rahul: Workaround: reduce `concurrency` to 1 or disable retries for 401s until next release. Not ideal but will stop the cascade.

maria: For immediate mitigation I pushed a small patch to the sample app to wrap token refresh with an asyncio.Lock. Patch diff:```
async def get_auth_token():
    async with _refresh_lock:
        if not token.is_valid():
            await token.refresh()
    return token.value
```

emily: Nice quick fix. We should patch the SDK core though. Adding dedupe to the auth middleware is safer than leaving it to sample apps. I'll open a PR.

tasha: Also saw weird interaction with paginator prefetch: it kept pulling next pages even while upstream returned 401s, so you still get a backlog. Maybe add pause-on-401 in the paginator loop.

rahul: Agreed. Proposed plan: (1) ship auth dedupe in py-sdk, (2) add small backoff-on-auth-failure hook in Paginator, (3) update sample app and docs to recommend token-locking when using short-lived creds.

ci-bot: deploy pipeline queued for branch fix/py-auth-dedupe — build started.

ops-bot: logs from staging: `2026-02-14T17:23:11Z svc-gateway 429 rate_limit exceeded tenant_id=acct-xyz concurrent=18 path=/v1/embeds`

maria: Thanks — can someone add a note to the onboarding checklist to call out this behavior for short-lived credentials? New customers using STS will hit it during ramp.

emily: Will do. I'll also add a small smoke test to the SDK CI that simulates a rotating token to catch regressions.

tasha: 👍 Repro steps + minimal patch are in the sampleapp branch: github.com/redwood/sampleapp/compare/sts-bounce.

maria: Marking this thread for follow-up after the PR lands. Big thanks everyone for the quick triage. :heart:
